caption: The drawing depicts a textile or tapestry design that comprises a geometric and ornamental composition with a predominantly red, blue, and cream color scheme. The central feature is a large diamond-shaped medallion containing a symmetrical floral motif in red, surrounded by patterns of leaves and small flowers in red and blue. Outside the diamond, the upper and right borders are decorated with scrolling blue patterns and floral accents. The left and bottom borders include vertical and horizontal rows of smaller squares and rectangles, each containing bird motifs, vases with flowers, and square floral designs. There are multiple bird figures in profile, primarily in blue, situated among plants, and repeated across different sections. The leftmost edge displays a decorative red fringe-like pattern. At the bottom, the year "1850" appears twice in red, and a line of text beneath reads "WOVE. BY. J.S. FOR S. GIBB." In the bottom right, the mirrored or upside-down text repeats the information. The entire design sits on a neutral cream background.
title: Coverlet
